news.title: Saint Louis University Students to Send Experiment to the International Space Station
news.summary_en: Saint Louis University students will design and send a science experiment to the International Space Station as part of Mission 22 of the Student Spaceflight Experiments Program (SSEP). SLU’s experiment will be flown to the International Space Station, along with others from around the country, in summer 2027.

news.title: SLU Community Welcomes Johnson at Reception
news.summary_en: Saint Louis University's new executive vice president and provost is optimistic. Speaking at her welcome reception, Kathy Johnson, Ph.D., laid out her vision for what she hopes to see during her time at SLU. In just a few weeks on the job, she said she's already seen the blueprint for success.
